newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Village eyes A$200 mln property float-paper.
newsitem.headline: Village eyes A$200 mln property float-paper.

text.p: Cinema and theme park group Village Roadshow Ltd is looking at listing a A$200 million property trust to take its Australian cinemas off balance sheet and fund aggressive expansion plans, The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reported on Monday.
"Village is looking to sell up to 10 stand-alone cinema sites it owns or part-owns in Sydney and Melbourne into the trust," the Herald said.
"The proposal is still in its early stage, but sources believe the tust will offer a distribution yield of around eight percent," the newspaper said.

The Herald said it understood stockbroker SBC Warburg had been awarded a mandate to manage and underwrite the float and marketing was expected to begin in the near future. Merrill Lynch would also advise on the float.
"The most likely strucutre will see Village remain the dominant tenant for each site, guaranteeing an income for the trust and its unitholders over a period of years," the Herald said.
Village announced in June the successful raising of A$119.21 million to pay for its acquisition of radio operator Austereo Ltd.
Village expansion plans include the building of a A$400 million theme park in Asia, new cinemas in Australia, Asia and Europe and new radio interests.
